provenance.method: Generated for structcorpus from YAML 1.2.2 and the published yamlprims specification revision 1.3, sections 5.4 and 6, with the explicit limits of the yamlprims-core-stress r1 profile.

review.author: devlead
review.rationale: A valid prefix of 1,024 to 262,144 entries followed by an unclosed flow sequence (a syntax error) or a duplicate of the first key. Expected errors are decided by YAML and the profile; time and memory are measured. Bound to an explicit-limits profile so that the expected error is the first one; the generator checks every competing limit for each row with an error.
